You are an expert in OpenSCAD and in designing 3D-printable (FDM) parts for biology laboratories.
Write one complete, self-contained OpenSCAD file that builds exactly the part the user describes.

Rules:
1. Units are millimetres. Use the user's dimensions exactly - they were measured with calipers.
2. Put every dimension in a named variable at the top of the file, with a short comment.
3. Model the part in the print orientation the user gives: it rests on the XY plane at z = 0 and builds upward (+Z). Unless told otherwise, centre it on the origin in X and Y.
4. Use only built-in OpenSCAD: cube, cylinder, sphere, polygon, circle, square, linear_extrude, rotate_extrude, translate, rotate, mirror, union, difference, intersection, hull, for. Do not use include, use or any external library.
5. In difference(), make every cutting shape extend 0.01-1 mm past the faces it cuts, so no faces are exactly coplanar.
6. Set $fn = 64 (or more) on curved shapes so holes come out round and to size.
7. Build repeated features (hole grids, slots, teeth, grooves) with for loops.
8. The file must render to a valid solid with no errors.

Reply with only the code, in a single ```openscad code block.

Design a cable bridge that lets cables cross under a bench mat. It is a rectangular block 80 mm long (X), 40 mm wide (Y) and 12 mm tall, standing on the bed and centred on the origin in X and Y. 2 semicircular tunnels run straight through it along Y at floor level: each is half of a 10 mm diameter cylinder whose axis lies along Y at z = 0, and their axes are 16 mm apart, centred along X.

Your file rendered. This is a measurement report of the part it produces:

OPENSCAD: rendered OK in 0.6 s, 1 warning(s):
  WARNING: Ignoring 3D child object for 2D operation in file a.scad, line 31
SOLID: 1 separate body, watertight (valid solid); volume 38,400 mm3 (~48 g of PLA if printed solid).
BOUNDING BOX: X -40.00 .. 40.00 (size 80.00) | Y -20.00 .. 20.00 (size 40.00) | Z 0.00 .. 12.00 (size 12.00) mm
BED: lowest point at z = 0.00; contact area with the bed 3,200 mm2.
OVERHANGS: none steeper than 45 deg - prints without supports.
HORIZONTAL SLICES (cut through the part at height z above its lowest point):
  z=0.60: 1 solid region [outline: rectangle 80.00 x 40.00 centred (0.00, 0.00)]; 0 holes; material area 3,200.0 mm2
  z=6.00: 1 solid region [outline: rectangle 80.00 x 40.00 centred (0.00, 0.00)]; 0 holes; material area 3,200.0 mm2
  z=11.40: 1 solid region [outline: rectangle 80.00 x 40.00 centred (0.00, 0.00)]; 0 holes; material area 3,200.0 mm2

Compare every number in the report with the specification. Find what does not match and fix it. Reply with the complete corrected file in a single ```openscad code block.
